remove_attributes <- function(x) {attributes(x) <- NULL; return(x)}

Read data and prediction grid, scale variables

# Read data
d <- readr::read_csv(paste0(home, "/data/clean/larval_size.csv")) |>
  mutate(
    yday_ct = yday - mean(yday),
    year_f = as.factor(year),
    species_f = as.factor(species),
    year_ct = year - median(year)
  ) |>
  mutate(across(
    .cols = c("temp", "chl"),
    .fns = scale,
    .names = "{.col}_sc"
  )) |> 
  mutate(temp_sq = temp_sc*temp_sc) |> 
  filter(!species == "Anguilla anguilla") |> 
  filter(!species == "Sardina pilchardus") |> 
  filter(!species == "Agonus cataphractus") |> 
  as.data.frame() |> 
  mutate(across(everything(), as.vector))

# Load prediction grid
pred_grid <- readr::read_csv(paste0(home, "/data/clean/pred_grid.csv")) |>
  filter(year %in% unique(d$year)) |>
  mutate(
    temp_sc = (temp - mean(d$temp, na.rm = TRUE)) / sd(d$temp, na.rm = TRUE),
    temp_sq = temp_sc*temp_sc,
    chl_sc = (chl - mean(chl, na.rm = TRUE)) / sd(chl, na.rm = TRUE),
    year_f = as.factor(year),
    year_ct = 0,
    yday_ct = 0
  ) |>
  mutate(keep = ifelse(lon < 10 & lat < 57.15, "N", "Y")) |>
  filter(keep == "Y") |>
  dplyr::select(-keep)

# First gather the elements common to all the covariate plots
covMapTheme <- plot_map +
  theme(
    legend.position.inside = c(0.25, 0.11),
    legend.direction = "horizontal",
    legend.key.width = unit(0.35, "cm"), # Decreased to fit multicovariates
    legend.key.height = unit(0.2, "cm"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 7),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 8)
  ) +
  geom_sf() +
  annotate("text",
    label = "Sweden", x = xmin2 + 0.95 * xrange, y = ymin2 + 0.75 * yrange,
    color = "gray50", size = 2.5
  ) +
  annotate("text",
    label = "Norway", x = xmin2 + 0.08 * xrange, y = ymin2 + 0.95 * yrange,
    color = "gray50", size = 2.5
  ) +
  annotate("text",
    label = "Denmark", x = xmin2 + 0.42 * xrange, y = ymin2 + 0.45 * yrange,
    color = "gray50", size = 2.5
  ) +
  guides(fill = guide_colorbar(
    position = "inside",
    title.position = "top",
    title.hjust = 0.5
  )) +
  NULL

# Generate the data and covariate maps
p_dat <- covMapTheme +
  geom_sf(data = rect, aes(group = ICESNAME), fill = NA, alpha = 0.1, color = "grey85") +
  geom_sf() +
  geom_point(
    data = d, aes(X * 1000, Y * 1000, color = species2),
    size = 0.5, alpha = 1
  ) +
  #scale_color_manual(values = coul, name = "Species") +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Paired", name = "Species") +
  guides(color = "none") +
  annotate("text", label = "(a)", x = -Inf, y = Inf, vjust = 1.5, hjust = -0.2,
           color = "gray40", size = 4) +
  annotation_scale(bar_cols = c("grey30", "white"), height = unit(0.1, "cm")) +
  annotation_north_arrow(
    location = "tr", which_north = "true", height = unit(0.85, "cm"),
    width = unit(0.85, "cm"), pad_x = unit(0.1, "in"), pad_y = unit(0.1, "in"),
    style = north_arrow_fancy_orienteering(
      fill = c("grey40", "white"),
      line_col = "grey20"
    )
  )

dens_pal <- alpha(brewer.pal(n = 10, name = "Paired"), 0.75)

quants <- quantile(d$length_mm)
quant_text <- paste0("Min: ", round(quants[1], 1),
                    "\n25%: ", round(quants[2], 1),
                    "\n50%: ", round(quants[3], 1),
                    "\n75%: ", round(quants[4], 1),
                    "\nMax: ", round(quants[5], 1))

size_plot <- ggplot(d, aes(length_mm)) +
  geom_histogram(aes(y = after_stat(count)), fill = "gray60", alpha = .5, color = NA) +
  geom_density(data = d, aes(y = after_stat(density * 30000), 
                              color = species2), linewidth = 1, alpha = 0.3) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Paired", name = "Species") +
  scale_color_manual(values = dens_pal) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    name = "Count",
    sec.axis = sec_axis(~ . / 30000, name = "Density")
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(expand = 0) +
  labs(x = "Length (mm)") +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        legend.key.size = unit(0.25, "cm"),
        legend.spacing.y = unit(0, "pt"),
        legend.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0),
        legend.title = element_blank(),
        legend.text = element_text(face = "italic", size = 7)) +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(ncol = 2), color = guide_legend(ncol = 2)) +
  annotate("text", label = "(b)", x = -Inf, y = Inf, vjust = 1.5, hjust = -0.2,
           color = "gray40", size = 4) +
  annotate("text", label = quant_text, x = Inf, y = Inf, 
           vjust = 1.1, hjust = 1.1, # Adjust these values as needed
           color = "gray40", size = 3)

p_tempCovMap <- covMapTheme +
  geom_raster(
    data = pred_grid |>
      group_by(X, Y) |>
      summarise(mean_temp = mean(temp)),
    aes(X * 1000, Y * 1000, fill = mean_temp)
  ) +
  geom_sf() + 
  annotate("text", label = "(a)", x = -Inf, y = Inf, vjust = 1.5, hjust = -0.2,
           color = "gray40", size = 4) +
  scale_fill_viridis(option = "magma", name = "Temperature (°C)") +
  guides(color = "none") +
  geom_segment(data = skag_kat_border, aes(x = X1*1000, xend = X2*1000,
                                           y = Y1*1000, yend = Y2*1000),
               alpha = 0.75, linetype = 3, color = "white") + 
  geom_label_repel(data = ann_text, aes(x = X*1000, y = Y*1000, label = label),
                   color = rev(pal), fill = "white", size = 2.5)
group_by: 2 grouping variables (X, Y)
summarise: now 5,057 rows and 3 columns, one group variable remaining (X)
p_chlCovMap <- covMapTheme +
  geom_raster(
    data = pred_grid |>
      group_by(X, Y) |>
      summarise(mean_chl = mean(chl)),
    aes(X * 1000, Y * 1000, fill = mean_chl)
  ) +
  geom_sf() + 
  annotate("text", label = "(b)", x = -Inf, y = Inf, vjust = 1.5, hjust = -0.2,
           color = "gray40", size = 4) +
  scale_fill_viridis(name = expression("Chl (mg m"^-3 * ")"), n.breaks = 4) +
  theme(
    axis.text.y = element_blank(),
    axis.title.y = element_blank()) +
  guides(color = "none") +
  geom_segment(data = skag_kat_border, aes(x = X1*1000, xend = X2*1000,
                                           y = Y1*1000, yend = Y2*1000),
               alpha = 0.75, linetype = 3, color = "white") + 
  geom_label_repel(data = stations |> filter(dataset == "Kattegatt"),
                   aes(x = X*1000, y = Y*1000, label = stationsnamn),
                   color = pal[1], fill = "white", size = 1.8, box.padding = .5) +
  geom_label_repel(data = stations |> filter(dataset == "Skagerrak"), aes(x = X*1000, y = Y*1000, label = stationsnamn),
                   color = pal[2], fill = "white", size = 1.8, box.padding = .5)

# Plot over time
trends <- pred_grid |>
  pivot_longer(c(temp, chl), names_to = "var") |>
  mutate(var = fct_recode(var,
    "Temperature" = "temp",
    "Chlorophyll" = "chl"
  )) |>
  summarise(value = mean(value), .by = c(var, year))
pivot_longer: reorganized (temp, chl) into (var, value) [was 156767x14, now 313534x14]
mutate: converted 'var' from character to factor (0 new NA)
summarise: now 62 rows and 3 columns, ungrouped
